answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust graph, while reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief gale of activity. EigenTrust normalization gives freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted incoming mass, a nebula of colluding accounts cannot amplify itself or pass consensus, and only long-lived, mutually validated behavior earns a haven in the decision set.
